# PR-comment goldens

Files ending in `-target.md` are **hand-written expected output** for the renderer
(CHECKPOINT A). They are not recorded model responses — those arrive in phase 2.

| File | Scenario |
|------|----------|
| `pr-comment-aws-fr007-enrichment-target.md` | Demo PR #1 (FR-007) + enrichment only |
| `pr-comment-aws-fr025-enrichment-target.md` | Demo PR #2 (FR-025) + enrichment only |
| `pr-comment-advisory-novel-target.md` | Synthetic: Advisory section with one novel observation |
